metals-medicine.title: Meditative Reflections and Guidance for Deepening the Art of Healing · Lecture III

history.title: The Saturn Oracle
history.body: Steiner names a Saturn tradition among the Atlantean initiation schools. He describes its initiates as reaching the higher beings particular to that tradition.

metals.title: Lead
metals.body: Steiner pairs Saturn with lead in a lecture on mystery schooling (GA 232) and in a lecture to physicians (GA 316). These are historical anthroposophical correspondences.

history.title: The Jupiter Oracle
history.body: Steiner describes a Jupiter tradition among the Atlantean schools, alongside those of Saturn and Mars.

metals.title: Tin
metals.body: Steiner pairs Jupiter with tin in a lecture on mystery schooling (GA 232) and in a lecture to physicians (GA 316). These are historical anthroposophical correspondences.

history.title: The Mars Oracle
history.body: Steiner includes a Mars tradition in his account of the schools that cultivated different kinds of spiritual perception in Atlantis.

metals.title: Iron
metals.body: Steiner pairs Mars with iron in a lecture on mystery schooling (GA 232) and in a lecture to physicians (GA 316). These are historical anthroposophical correspondences.

blood.title: Iron in blood and the language of freedom
blood.body: Steiner brings the Mars sphere and iron in human blood into his account of free spiritual activity. This is the explanatory framework of the lecture.

history.title: The Venus Oracle
history.body: Steiner describes the Venus Oracle as an initiation stream guided by a leading spirit whose group withdrew from the Sun.

metals.title: Copper
metals.body: Steiner pairs Venus with copper in a lecture on mystery schooling (GA 232) and in a lecture to physicians (GA 316). These are historical anthroposophical correspondences.

history.title: The Mercury Oracle
history.body: Steiner describes the Mercury Oracle as a distinct initiation stream, guided by a leading spirit, alongside the Venus stream.

metals.title: Mercury (quicksilver)
metals.body: Steiner pairs Mercury with mercury (quicksilver) in a lecture on mystery schooling (GA 232) and in a lecture to physicians (GA 316). These are historical anthroposophical correspondences.

metals.title: Gold
metals.body: Steiner pairs Sun with gold in a lecture on mystery schooling (GA 232) and in a lecture to physicians (GA 316). These are historical anthroposophical correspondences.

metals.title: Silver
metals.body: Steiner pairs Moon with silver in a lecture on mystery schooling (GA 232) and in a lecture to physicians (GA 316). These are historical anthroposophical correspondences.
